title: Spyglass: General Availability
summary: We're excited to announce that Spyglass has officially graduated from beta, delivering powerful new insights and capabilities to all users.

title: Complete File Control in Your Editor
summary: Experience unparalleled control over your documents and images directly in the editor, with intuitive tools to manage uploads, downloads, and customize their appearance.

title: Unveiling Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new, dedicated roadmap page on our website, offering complete transparency into our product's exciting journey with insights into what's delivered, next, and planned.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more intuitive experience with larger, easier-to-click checkboxes that seamlessly integrate with your workflow and visual style.

title: Enhanced Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Elevate your teamwork with seamless real-time collaboration, making it easier than ever to create and innovate together.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Easily find and collaborate on shared content with friends, as all relevant items now appear directly in your search results.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're expanding Noeko to support a vibrant array of international languages, making it accessible to users around the world.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Experience ultimate transparency and control as we open source Noeko, empowering our community to contribute and evolve the platform together.

title: Intelligent Knowledge Map
summary: Gain unparalleled control and clarity over your ideas by filtering, exploring, and collaborating within an enhanced visual map of your knowledge.

title: Smart Search & Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your knowledge with powerful new filters and the ability to save customized search results as personalized collections.

title: Dynamic Linked Content
summary: Organize your thoughts more intuitively with dynamic new display modes for linked content, offering greater interactivity and clarity right where you need it.

title: Noeko Self-Hostable and Premium Plans
summary: We are excited to launch Noeko with flexible self-hosting options and premium plans, empowering users with greater control and advanced features.

title: Personalize Your Experience with Enhanced and New Themes
summary: We're enhancing your visual experience by refining existing themes and introducing a diverse array of stunning new designs to perfectly personalize your workspace.

title: Personalized Daily Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized welcome on your homepage, as we ensure our greetings always accurately reflect the current time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Organization
summary: Efficiently manage your content by instantly unapplying tags and performing other crucial actions directly within your tag views, saving you valuable time.

title: Universal Content Input
summary: Gain richer insights and manage all your knowledge in one place by seamlessly integrating a wide variety of content formats, from videos to web pages.
